title: Divider
text: Model ideal frequency-independent dividers or combiners with S-parameters, {Select component} sets Divider type T power; {Number of divider outports} sets the number of Wilkinson power divider outports, {Reference impedances (Ohm)} sets the reference impedance of divider and {Ground and hide negative terminals} sets the ground RF circuit terminals. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Select component
params.values: Divider type T power divider (default) | Resistive power divider | Wilkinson power divider | Tee H-plane (S33=0) | Tee E-plane

params.name: Number of divider outports
params.values: Number of Wilkinson power divider outports 2 (default) | nonnegative integer in the range ( 1, 65 ]

params.name: Reference impedances (Ohm)
params.values: Reference impedance of divider 50 (default) | positive scalar | three-tuple vector

params.name: Ground and hide negative terminals
params.values: Ground RF circuit terminals on (default) | off
